audit_title: PhantomNet V3 — Independent Production Readiness Revalidation Scorecard
methodology: Empirical Hostile Verification (No production claim without executable evidence)

SEC-01.name: Dynamic Route Authentication
SEC-01.finding: 37 non-public routes completely exposed without authentication (e.g. /api/v1/model/*, /api/sentinel/*, /api/v1/patterns/*, /api/stats, /analyze-traffic)

SEC-02.name: RBAC Enforcement
SEC-02.finding: Analyst role correctly restricted from admin routes with HTTP 403

SEC-03.name: Honeypot Ingestion Origin Auth
SEC-03.finding: HMAC-SHA256 signature verification enforced; unsigned requests rejected with 401

SEC-05.name: Threat Scoring Fail-Closed
SEC-05.finding: Deterministic fallback heuristic when ML engine unavailable

SEC-06.name: Sensitive Data Redaction
SEC-06.finding: LogSanitizer redacts passwords, tokens, and keys in logs

SEC-07.name: CORS & Security Headers
SEC-07.finding: Strict CORS, CSP, HSTS, and X-Content-Type-Options headers active

SEC-08.name: Rate Limiting
SEC-08.finding: Rate limiting active on authentication endpoints

SEC-09.name: Pydantic Input Validation
SEC-09.finding: Malformed JSON and schema deviations rejected with 422 Unprocessable Entity

SEC-10.name: Secret Lifecycle & Rotation
SEC-10.finding: Single-key architecture; zero-downtime rotation unsupported without token invalidation

SEC-11.name: Network Isolation
SEC-11.finding: Honeypot network isolated with internal: true; cross-network isolation verified

DUR-01.name: Ingestion Throughput (500 EPS)
DUR-01.finding: Synchronous Redis calls on async event loop bottleneck real throughput to < 10 EPS

DUR-02.name: Redis Stream Durability
DUR-02.finding: AOF appendfsync everysec active and verified in redis-server config

DUR-03.name: Producer-Consumer Decoupling
DUR-03.finding: Ingestion gateway has zero direct DB connections; publishes to Redis Streams

DUR-04.name: Dead Letter Queue (DLQ)
DUR-04.finding: Poison pill events routed to DLQ stream without halting consumer pipeline

DUR-06.name: Database Transactions & ACID
DUR-06.finding: Transaction context managers enforce atomicity and rollback on error

GOV-01.name: Event Retention & Pruning
GOV-01.finding: Retention pruner exists but is disabled by default (SENTINEL_RETENTION_CLEANUP_ENABLED=false)

GOV-02.name: Continuous Archiving & PITR
GOV-02.finding: WAL archiving restored after fixing volume permissions (5 WALs archived); automated restore drill manual

GOV-03.name: Forensic Artifact Hashing
GOV-03.finding: SHA-256 hash chains for audit log entries verified

OBS-02.name: Distributed Tracing
OBS-02.finding: X-Correlation-ID generated and propagated across headers

OBS-03.name: Structured JSON Logging
OBS-03.finding: Logs structured in JSON format with ISO-8601 timestamps

RT-01.name: WebSocket Broadcast
RT-01.finding: WebSocket endpoint broadcasts live event telemetry to connected clients

RT-02.name: WebSocket Reconnection Jitter
RT-02.finding: Hardcoded setTimeout(connect, 3000); zero exponential backoff, zero jitter

PERF-01.name: Ingestion P99 < 100ms
PERF-01.finding: Real P99 latency is > 3,000ms under concurrent TCP load due to event-loop blocking

PERF-02.name: API Query Response Time
PERF-02.finding: Standard read endpoints return in < 50ms under normal load

PERF-03.name: Resource Saturation Limits
PERF-03.finding: Background ML training starves 1.0 CPU container, causing HTTP timeouts

ML-01.name: Walk-Forward Benchmark
ML-01.finding: Test runs on 1,500 synthetic random numbers; registry model never evaluated

ML-02.name: ML Metrics SLOs
ML-02.finding: Actual model has 0.0 metrics in index; AnomalyDetector achieves only 14.5% recall on real ground truth

ML-03.name: Adversarial Evasion Robustness
ML-03.finding: Test hardcoded is_malicious=True bypassing ML; without bypass, mutated payload evades critical detection

ML-04.name: Model Inference Latency
ML-04.finding: Real inference latency measured at 6.8ms - 16.6ms (average ~8.2ms), well below 20ms SLO

ML-05.name: Model Registry & Versioning
ML-05.finding: models_index.json tracks models, artifacts, versions, and timestamps

OPS-01.name: Container Hardening
OPS-01.finding: Remediated startup crash with tmpfs logs; non-root UID 10001, ALL caps dropped, read-only rootfs verified

OPS-02.name: Graceful Shutdown
OPS-02.finding: Uvicorn handles SIGTERM cleanly without dropping active connections

OPS-03.name: Auto-Restart Policy
OPS-03.finding: restart: unless-stopped configured on all containers in docker-compose.yml

OPS-04.name: Automated Database Backup & Restore
OPS-04.finding: Clean DB restore and hash-chain continuity verified in test_backup_restore_e2e.py and backup_base.sh

OPS-05.name: Alembic Migrations
OPS-05.finding: Alembic version table and revision stamped in PostgreSQL

OPS-06.name: Infrastructure as Code
OPS-06.finding: docker-compose.yml defines complete multi-service stack reproducibly

UI-01.name: Auth Token Storage Security
UI-01.finding: AdminPanel.jsx stores JWT in localStorage, exposing it to XSS token theft

UI-02.name: Frontend CSP Defenses
UI-02.finding: Nginx configuration enforces Content Security Policy

conditions: Ingestion traffic capped at 200 EPS per instance until edge rate limiting / Go gateway deployed
AttackClassifier_Enhanced model gated in Staging; production relies on AnomalyDetector and heuristic engine
